your_name.title: your name
your_name.description:
Your Name is a 2016 Japanese animated romantic fantasy drama film written and directed by Makoto Shinkai.

Movie Details

• Original Title: Kimi no Na wa. (君の名は。)
• Release Date: August 26, 2016 (Japan)
• Running Time: 107 minutes (1 hour 47 minutes)
• Production Studio: CoMix Wave Films
• Distributed By: Toho
• Music By: Radwimps
• Box Office: US$355.3 million

Main Characters and Cast (Japanese Voices)

• Taki Tachibana: Voiced by Ryunosuke Kamiki — A high school boy living in Tokyo who works part-time at an Italian restaurant.
• Mitsuha Miyamizu: Voiced by Mone Kamishiraishi — A high school girl living in the rural mountain town of Itomori who wishes to live in Tokyo.

Plot Summary

• Body Swapping: Taki and Mitsuha mysteriously begin switching bodies randomly while they sleep, leaving notes for each other to navigate their daily lives.
• Time Discrepancy: They discover they are separated by three years—Mitsuha lives in 2013 and Taki lives in 2016.
• The Comet: A comet named Tiamat approaches Earth and destroys Itomori in Mitsuha's timeline, killing the town's residents.
• Saving the Town: Taki visits Mitsuha's family shrine, drinks her traditional kuchikami-sake, and returns to her body on the day of the disaster to evacuate the town.
• Reunion: Years later, having forgotten each other's names and faces due to the timeline shift, they finally cross paths and recognize each other on parallel trains in Tokyo.
